caption: The drawing depicts a single glass bowl with a wide opening, a rounded body that narrows toward the base, and sits atop a short, sturdy foot. The bowl is decorated with a pattern: the upper portion features vertical ribbed lines, while the lower bulbous section displays a detailed crosshatch, diamond-like texture. The pedestal base echoes the bowl's patterns but in a subtler, less pronounced manner. The glass appears transparent and is primarily rendered in shades of blue, grey, and white, giving a sense of reflections and transparency. The background is plain and beige, with no other objects except a small, outlined side view of the bowl with dimensions indicated in the lower right corner.
title: Glass Bowl
